result.summary: Diagnosed ISS-0112 as Category F test-infrastructure drift: the shared db_test migration ledger reports 1 row for 97 migration files, schema objects and tenant schemas do not match the recorded baseline, and production-defaulted LEGACY_RLS test tenants leak past cleanup. The 42 integration failures are clustered consequences of INV-TI-1/INV-TI-2 violations, so severity is BLOCKER under the Green-Main Gate.
